about.name: Coach Ray Pyle
about.title: DC/LBs
about.bio:
Coach Ray Pyle is a proven 46086 specialist with 3 years of coaching experience at Vista Grande HS. Known for a disciplined, film-first approach, Coach Pyle develops intelligent, technically sound players who make an impact on every down.

If you're looking to elevate your game on the defensive side of the ball and compete at the next level, Coach Pyle's coaching is where that journey starts.

hero.headline: Vista Grande HS's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized defensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: 46086 Defense Installation
services.description: Full 46086 system installation — formations, assignments, stunts, and blitz packages tailored to your personnel.

services.title: Film & Opponent Scouting
services.description: Tendency charting, defensive game-planning, and film breakdown sessions that give your defense the edge before kickoff.

services.title: Linebacker & Secondary Development
services.description: Position-specific coaching for front-seven and DB players — gap control, coverage technique, communication, and tackling.
